notes: Mobile Harness Code v1.20.0 — background execution reliability. Every DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code and Antigravity run is now journaled to a crash-surviving session record, so if Android kills the app process mid-task you get an 'interrupted' banner on the next launch instead of silently losing the run (resume stays manual and fail-closed — a possibly side-effecting task is never auto-repeated). The PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK is now re-acquired before its 90-minute timeout so a single long agent turn or build keeps CPU wakefulness. Terminal commands (gradle/npm/python/…) now run under the same foreground service as the agents, so they survive leaving Appbuilder. Signed (V2) with the unchanged production certificate.
